description: StayVisible connects ChatGPT to live vacation rental inventory. Tell it where you want to go, your dates, and how many guests, and it searches available properties, checks real-time availability against the host's booking calendar, returns an itemized price quote, and generates a direct booking link to the host's own site. No OTA commission, no app to install, no account required.
